sensors.name: left light sensor LLIGHT, light from above

control_flow: followInTheDark: if the left light sensor reads below 70 %, look at the line tracker: below 90 % curve left 10/30, above 90 % curve right 30/10, otherwise call avoidWalls; if bright, call avoidWalls.
avoidWalls: in dim light, turn right 20° if something is on the left, else turn left 20° if something is on the right, else call driveInTheDark; if bright, call driveInTheDark.
driveInTheDark: in dim light drive forward at 30 %; if bright call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left 10/40; else curve right 40/10.

likely_intent.description: In dim light, follow a black line when one is under the robot and drive straight when there is none; in bright light, follow the line as before.
